具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗

subtitles.zh: 我想先从红鸟说起，之后我们肯定会谈到派拉蒙。
subtitles.en: I want to start with the red bird, we're obviously going to get the paramount.

subtitles.zh: 但你创立红鸟时，它还是一家规模较小、专注体育的私募机构。
subtitles.en: But you started red bird at the time, relatively small sports focus private equity firm.

subtitles.zh: 你如何把它打造成全球最大的体育和媒体市场参与者之一？
subtitles.en: What has been your strategy for building it into one of the biggest sports and media investors in the world?

subtitles.zh: 我在2014年创立了它，人们称我们为体育公司，我觉得只是因为如今体育的热潮。
subtitles.en: Well, I launched it in 2014 and we get referred to as a sports firm and I think it's just because of the euphoria with sports today.

subtitles.zh: 我参与体育领域已有25年，但我创立红鸟并不是为了做体育。
subtitles.en: I've been investing in sports for 25 years but I didn't start red bird to be in sports.

subtitles.zh: 我创立红鸟是为了做我热爱的**，而实际上我热爱的**方式在私募股权中并不常见。

subtitles.zh: 所以，红鸟原本是打算成为一家增长型权益资产机构，主要关注知识产权行业，也就是如今的体育、媒体和娱乐、体育媒体。
subtitles.en: So, you know, red bird was really meant to be a growth equity shop in pretty much intellectual property industries which is today sports, media and entertainment, sports media.

subtitles.zh: 它实际上是和最好的知识产权持有者合作，与他们一起建立业务。
subtitles.en: And it's really partnering with the best intellectual property rights holders and building businesses with them.

subtitles.zh: 这就是它的本质。坦率地说，这要追溯到25年前，我想我谈过这个，我职业生涯的重大突破是遇到乔治·斯坦布伦纳并创建了S网络。
subtitles.en: That's really what it was. And frankly, it goes back 25 years, you know, I think I've talked about this the big break in my career was meeting George Steinbrenner and creating the S network.

subtitles.en: That model of coming together with a rights holder and creating a company like that to monetize the intellectual property of the Yankees, selling it 10 years later to Rupert Murdoch for

subtitles.en: $4 billion. It proved the point that Steinbrenner had basically which was, you know, if we could find a way to monetize the intellectual property of the Yankees, you should be able to

subtitles.zh: 比球队本身更有价值。
subtitles.en: that should be worth more than the team itself.
